professor_requirement_addressed: determine a valid cluster-size envelope before the full type-I/power grid, while preserving the response-average marginal FNR estimand and exact matched independent provenance-cluster counts
inference_candidate: restricted-null beta-binomial nuisance plug-in Monte Carlo test
reason_for_returning_to_this_candidate: among tested procedures it had the best calibration under matched cluster counts and only failed clearly under high/vhigh cluster-size variation in the logit-normal stress generator
screen_purpose: identify whether a bounded, operationally enforceable provenance-cluster size envelope can remove the misspecification-driven type-I inflation without changing the professor-approved estimand or claim
screen_decision_rule: A design point is clearly inadmissible if the lower endpoint of the Monte Carlo 95% Clopper-Pearson interval exceeds the nominal alpha in any tested boundary/generator combination. This screen is only for pruning. Any surviving design must be rechecked at high repetitions with beta-binomial, two-point, and logit-normal generators before final freeze.
important: Do not interpret a passing screen as a frozen design or sample size. The next step after this screen is a focused high-repetition confirmation of the surviving envelope/G region, followed immediately by the professor-requested full type-I/power grid and Y1/Y0 quota derivation.

screen_result.reason: All screen designs survived the clear-failure rule; the tight envelope is advanced because it is the narrowest operationally feasible design and therefore limits cluster-size heterogeneity without changing the response-average estimand.
screen_result.important: This advances a candidate envelope only. The minimum/cap and sample sizes are not frozen until the full type-I/power grid and targeted high-repetition confirmation are complete.
